notes.title: Update v1.1 now available
notes.content:
[b][u]Between Me and The Night - full release update v1.1 now available[/u][/b]

NEW - Improved the inventory system by removing object size limitation and increasing the number of slots to 6.

NEW - Additional graphical feedback during the clock event. 

NEW - Additional text clues for some objects.

FIX - Issue in which some players could not trigger some Apartment and High School achievements.

FIX - Random issue when the sprite of the player would not display correctly when eaten by the ghost.

FIX - Random issue when lights could not be switched back on after they had been eaten by the ghost and the time delay had elapsed.

FIX - Removed open door prompt during Giant Head event.

FIX - Issue when dropping some objects from the inventory caused them to disappear and become irretrievable.

FIX - Improved the spawn locations of the ghost and trigger points.

FIX - Minor bug and graphical fixes.

**To make sure you are running this lastest update the version number (v1.1) is displayed on the Main Menu. If the game has not been updated to v1.1 please restart Steam.**

As always, please keep your feedback coming by posting in the Community Forum - http://steamcommunity.com/app/285070


RainDance LX and Lace Games

notes.title: HUGE Between Me and The Night update OUT NOW!!
notes.content:
[b][u]Between Me and The Night – Early Access Update Version 2.0
[/u][/b]

This huge update of “Between Me and The Night” brings the whole game, fully playable, to Early Access.

New for this update:

•	The complete game, playable from beginning to end for the first time!
•	Includes all new puzzles and events.
•	Finalised story and game flow.
•	Brand new objects
•	Discover the background story through hidden objects.
•	Three main locations to explore.
•	Improved combat and focus mode in “Otherworld”.
•	Additional enemy types and new AI behaviour.
•	Full day and night cycle.
•	Improved Inspect/Inventory modes.
•	Enhanced in-game text system.
•	Multiple improvements to both performance and stability.
•	New Visual FX.
•	New SFX and Music.
•	Full text – English/Russian/German/Spanish/Portuguese.

We hope you will enjoy this BIG update and as always, we look forward to your feedback!

RainDance LX and Lace Games

notes.title: Early Access Update v1.0 Released
notes.content:
Early Access Update v1.0

First major Early Access update has now been released 09/09/2015

- New - added feedback for inventory full and unreachable objects
- New - added "tip rocks" for the otherworld scenes to explain combat focus
- New - added death collider to the bottom of the otherworld
- New - added controls menu with a splash screen with control scheme
- New - added selective buttons for in menu 
- Fix - inventory sizes and objects positioning
- Fix - inventory capacity
- Fix - mom animation in kitchen
- Fix - ghost behaviour and bug if you were captured on the stairs
- Fix - sitting/climbing bug that prevented player from being able to move
- Fix - colliders for the otherworld
- Fix - backyard stairs
- Fix - menu control response with controller
- Improved - climb up and down animation flicker
- Improved - minor graphical fixes on scenes and object repositioning

Thank you to all those who have purchased the game. Please keep your feedback coming by posting in the Community Forum - http://steamcommunity.com/app/285070
